name: Static FM
summary: A 404 page where your page has gone off the air: tune a walnut radio through static to live stations
about: A full not-found page built around a glowing walnut radio. The dial hisses with static where the missing page used to play, while six live stations stand for the pages that still work, each with its own oscilloscope wave, signal meter and dancing equaliser. Visitors can tune by hand, press preset keys, seek, or type what they want and watch the needle scan to it.
how: The radio warms up: the dial lights, the needle sweeps across the band and settles on the static at 104.0
Until you touch anything it tours the stations by itself, so the page plays like a short video
Drag the big knob or the dial, scroll on it, use the arrow keys, or press the six preset keys and the Seek buttons
Type a word like pricing or jobs and press Scan; the needle sweeps to the matching station and offers Tune in
Locking a station lights the ON AIR sign, pulses the speaker and sends notes floating out; find all six for a finale
Sound is off by default; switch it on to hear real static and a little tune for each station
